name: Uno Minda Ltd
_note: Fact base for the Uno Minda initiation (consolidated, Rs crore unless stated). Only sources published on or before 30-Sep-2026. FY26 = year to Mar-2026; Q1FY27 = Apr-Jun 2026.

ar26.what: Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (accounts approved 16-May-2026; AGM 31-Jul-2026)

profile.what: India's largest maker of automotive switches and horns and of 2W seats and PV alloy wheels, and its third-largest automotive lighting maker (ICICI Direct, 5-Aug-2026); 78 plants, 28 product lines, 17 JVs/technical licences, group turnover (incl. JVs) Rs25,203 cr in FY26.
divisions: Switches (2W switches; 4W switches via Uno Mindarika, 51%, Tokai Rika 49%)
Castings (4W and 2W alloy wheels, aluminium die casting)
Seating (2W/CV seats; PV seating via Uno Minda Tachi-S from Q4FY28)
Green Mobility (alternate fuel/CNG via Minda Westport 76%; EV systems: 2W/3W chargers, DC-DC, motors; 4W EV powertrain via Uno Minda Auto Innovations)
Others (sensors and ADAS, acoustics/horns, blow moulding, controllers, aftermarket incl. batteries, Uno Minda Katolec EMS, sunroof from end-FY27)
profile.customers: Two customers each above 10% of FY26 revenue (none in FY25) (AR FY26 note 32). Key 4W client Maruti Suzuki (Emkay, 5-Aug-2026).

fy26.capexSplit: Rs861 cr expansion projects, Rs149 cr CSN land, rest sustaining (q4call)
fy26.src: AR FY26 consolidated statements and notes 21, 22, 30, 32, 42; q4call; q1deck p18

jv._note: Equity-accounted, shown below EBITDA as 'share of profit of associates and JVs' (net of tax); Screener adds it to other income.
fy26: Toyoda Gosei Uno Minda (airbags, steering wheels, weather strips)
jv.denso_ivi_order: Rs600 cr peak annual value (vs Denso Ten JV FY26 revenue Rs846 cr), SOP Q3FY29 (q4call)
jv.src: AR FY26 consolidated notes 7 and 44(C); related-party note (dividends); q1call

nci._note: Profit attributable to non-controlling interests, FY26 (Rs crore): NCI share of subsidiary profit.
fy26: Uno Minda EV Systems (NCI bought out in FY26)
nci.fy26Buyout: 49.9% of Uno Minda EV Systems from FRIWO for Rs141.28 cr plus E-drive assets Rs58.01 cr (AR note 41)

q1fy27.detail: 4W switches (Uno Mindarika) Rs525 cr +24%; 4W alloy wheels Rs566 cr, 2W alloy wheels Rs284 cr, die casting Rs248 cr (+66%); alternate fuel Rs184 cr, EV systems Rs186 cr (+130%), UMAI (4W EV) Rs123 cr, EV controllers Rs37 cr; sensors/ADAS Rs250 cr, acoustics Rs225 cr, blow moulding Rs125 cr, non-EV controllers Rs80 cr; aftermarket Rs336 cr (+ OEM spares Rs254 cr = 11%); exports from India Rs228 cr vs Rs141 cr.
q1fy27.marginDrivers: Commodity and gas inflation only partly recovered; pass-through at cost diluted margin ~40bp; minimum-wage increases (Haryana ~35%); offset by efficiencies and operating leverage. Gross margin down three quarters in a row.
q1fy27.industry: Production 9.69 mn (+22%): PV 1.45 mn (+17%), 2W 7.25 mn (+23%), CV 0.29 mn (+15%); e-PV penetration 6.8%, e-2W 9.2%.

guidance.ebitdaMargin: 11% +/-50bp for FY27, 'with a bias towards the higher end' (q1call, 4-Aug-2026; also q4call 18-May-2026, including known start-up costs)
guidance.capexFY27: Rs1,750 cr: ~Rs650 cr sustaining, ~Rs1,100 cr growth, balance land (q4call); unchanged in q1call. Announced projects Rs3,788 cr, Rs1,406 cr spent to 30-Jun-2026; ~Rs2,000 cr more over 18-24 months (q1call).
guidance.growth: Expects to keep outperforming industry volumes; 7 of 11 projects start or ramp up in FY27; EV powertrain (Khed, H2FY27) and sunroof (Bawal, end-FY27) start.
guidance.exports: Physical exports from India ~Rs600 cr in FY26; 'expect this to cross Rs1,500 cr in next few years' (q4call).
guidance.evPowertrain: Khed (Rs437 cr) + CSN (Rs549 cr) + CSN EV casting (Rs210 cr; ~Rs300 cr per call): revenue potential >Rs2,500 cr, up to ~Rs3,000 cr at peak (q4call). Inovance JV: India Press Note 3 approval received; China approval pending under tightened rules (q1call).
guidance.orders: 2W lamps ~Rs450 cr peak (SOP H2FY28); seating exports ~Rs390 cr peak (end-FY28/FY29); sunroof order book >Rs500 cr; 2W display ~Rs200 cr (SOP Q4FY27); 4W PV seating anchor customer (Rs320 cr plant, SOP Q4FY28, >2x asset turn).

history: Started with ammeters; added horns, automotive switches and lighting
4W switches through Uno Mindarika (Tokai Rika JV); Indonesia and Vietnam plants; batteries, blow moulding, CNG kits, die casting
Bought Clarton (horns, Spain); alloy-wheel JV with Kosei
Bought Rinder (lighting, Spain); JVs with Katolec (EMS) and Onkyo (infotainment)
Bought and merged Harita Seating; Tachi-S 4W seating JV; Dayou (LPDC wheels) and Asentec (sensors) licences; 2W/3W EV portfolio (the company was formerly Minda Industries, NSE: MINDAIND)
Bought the rest of Minda Kosei Aluminium Wheel; Minda Westport stake from 50% to 76%; StarCharge licence

Merged the Kosei entities into Uno Minda; Inovance JV (EV powertrain) and Aisin (sunroof) tie-ups; 2W seat business of Sundaram Auto Components (Mar-2025); FRIWO's 49.9% of Uno Minda EV Systems (FY26)
Board approved amalgamation of Minda Onkyo India (99% held after buying Onkyo's 19% for Rs1.02 cr) with appointed date 1-Apr-2026; swap 6 Uno Minda shares per 10,000 Minda Onkyo shares (immaterial)
